text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring G1 races are underway. First, Kitasan Black will be running the Osaka Hai. After her, Satono Diamond will take on the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After her good performance at the long distance Kikuka Sho and Arima Kinen, people wonder if the Osaka Hai is too short for Kitasan Black, but she ignores them and makes for the track.
